text_block_list.text: One day, while training with Bubble Gum Fellow as usual...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *CHOMP--!!*

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwa-ha-ha-ha!
Windy-chan has arrived!
How's that! Shaking in your boots, are yaaa!?

Wondering what was going on, Shinko Windy
suddenly sprang a prank on you.
She clacks the teeth of the lion dance mask...
choice_data_list: Hmm, let's save playtime for later, alright...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-nyah!
Catch me if you can, da nodaaaa~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaiiit!
Not today! I won't let you get away with this today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Teyaaa! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Hmph!
You won't hit me with that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "What!? You cheeky brat!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Here, over this way...
Just two more steps... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hm? The soil here is damp...
I see, a pitfall trap!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaah!! You saw right through meee!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Now, I've got you cornered.
Give up quietly.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ununununu~! Hmph!
Windy-chan hasn't lost!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bleh! Dummy dummy dummy!
You're completely helpless without your gum anyway!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Say something, damn it...!
Y-You...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Did that really make you mad...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's true...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: So, take that as payback!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah~!
My forehead! My forehead hurts sooo much!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, if that frustrates you, try and pay me back.
By overtaking me, that is!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaaahhhhh!
I'll bite you! Windy-chan is definitely gonna bite youuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I wonder if you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please time me, okay?

And so, the two engaged in a ferocious run.
Blazing down the track with everything they had...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*...!
I'll let you off easy for today...!
You just remember this...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah, see you later♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Whew! That was a good workout.
I didn't expect them to stick to me so hard!"
choice_data_list: So this was the plan all along...

text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow lets out a chuckle.
Neither lashing out in anger nor simply ignoring it,
it is a response quintessential to her...
choice_data_list: That was an insanely fast chase!
Looks like hanging out will boost your Stamina.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was so much fun♪
She's strong, so running together with her really helps me out.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Besides, she's actually a good girl deep down!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
Fufu, I'll hang out with you anytime♪
After all, I want us to become even closer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Someday, I hope we can become close enough to train together right from the start!"
